recognize_zh: 腹水抹片裡粗箭頭指的是胞質深藍、核偏位並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞，和周圍胞質滿是空泡的巨噬細胞（雙箭頭）形成對比；小箭頭則是一顆小淋巴樣細胞，用來比較大小。
features: Plasma cells (large arrow) with abundant dense basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nucleus and paranuclear clearing
Other plasmacytoid cells with deep blue cytoplasm scattered among macrophages
Vacuolated macrophages with foamy cytoplasm and reniform nuclei (double arrow)
Small lymphocyte for size comparison (small arrow); occasional neutrophils
describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows numerous foamy, vacuolated macrophages (double arrow) with scattered plasma cells characterized by abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and paranuclear hofs (large arrow). A small lymphocyte (small arrow) and occasional neutrophils are present. No clusters of epithelial malignant cells are seen. In the clinical setting of plasma cell myeloma, findings are suggestive of myelomatous peritoneal effusion, to be confirmed by CD138 and kappa/lambda studies.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells in inflammatory ascites
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are sparse, mature-appearing and polytypic, while myeloma cells are clonal with light chain restriction.
Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, peripheral cytoplasmic fringe and cohesive groupings and stain for calretinin/WT1 rather than CD138 with light chain restriction.
Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma or marginal zone lymphoma shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes to plasma cells with a CD20-positive B-cell component.
